sn48.58:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate Sūkarakhatāyaṃ || || 2.
sn48.58:1.2: Tatra kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtam āmantesi ||
sn48.58:1.3: kiṃ nu kho Sāriputta atthavasaṃ sampassamāno khīṇāsavo bhikkhu Tathāgate vā Tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccākāraṃ pavattamāno pavatteti || || Anuttaraṃ
sn48.58:1.4: hi bhante yogakkhemaṃ sampassamāno khīṇāsavo bhikkhu Tathāgate vā Tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccākāram pavattamāno pavattetī ti || || 3.
sn48.58:1.6: anuttaraṃ hi Sāriputta yoyakkhemam sampassamāno khīṇāsavo bhikkhu Tathāgate vā Tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccākāram pavattamāno pavattetī ti || || 4.
sn48.58:2.1: Katamo ca Sāriputta anuttaro yogakkhemo yaṃ sampassamāno khīṇāsavo bhikkhu Tathāgate vā Tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccākāram pavattamāno pavattetī ti || || 5.
sn48.58:2.2: Idha bhante khīṇāsavo bhikkhu saddhindriyam bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmim ||
sn48.58:2.7: Ayaṃ kho bhante anuttaro yogakkhemo yaṃ sampassamāno khīṇāsavo bhikkhu Tathāgate vā Tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccākāram pavattamāno pavattetī ti || || 6.
sn48.58:2.9: eso hi Sāriputta anuttaro yogakkhemo yam sampassamāno khīnāsavo bhikkhu Tathāgate vā Tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccākāram pavattamāno pavatteti || || 7.
sn48.58:3.1: Katamo ca Sāriputta paramanipaccākāro yaṃ khīṇāsavo bhikkhu Tathāgate vā Tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccākāram pavattamāno pavattetī ti || || 8.
sn48.58:3.2: Idha bhante khīṇāsavo bhikkhu satthari sagāravo viharati sappatisso || dhamme sagāravo viharati sappatisso || saṅghe- || sikkhāya- || samādhismiṃ sagāravo viharati sappatisso || ||
sn48.58:3.3: Ayaṃ kho bhante paramanipaccākāro yaṃ khīṇāsavo bhikkhu Tathāgate vā Tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccākāram pavattamāno pavattetī ti || || 9.
sn48.58:3.5: eso hi Sāriputta paramanipaccākāro yaṃ khīṇāsavo bhikkhu Tathāgate vā Tathāgatasāsane vā paramanipaccākāram pavattamāno pavattetī ti || || 1.
